**Bottom line:** Don't build a true open, permanent self-serve free tier right now. Add a narrower composite instead — a self-serve sandbox/demo environment plus a formalized, sales-assisted, time-limited trial sourced from your existing outbound/referral channels — run as an explicitly gated pilot with pre-committed metrics.
